title: Expressing concern about the growing problem of book banning and the proliferation of threats to freedom of expression in the United States.
latestAction: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committee on Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
